_schema.rule: Every new feature entry MUST include `outcome_metric` (named queryable metric + 90-day threshold + kill criterion). Features missing `outcome_metric` are invalid. The locked source of truth for outcome metrics is `~/Vaults/JKKNKB/Strategy/Locked-Initiatives.md` — features.json mirrors but does not override. See memory `feedback_outcome_metric_first.md` and `feedback_kill_criterion_forward_clauses_must_fire.md`.

outcome_metric_fields.metric_name: Queryable database column / dashboard chart / Supabase function output. Single number or yes/no on verdict-date. NOT 'improve X' or 'better Y'.
outcome_metric_fields.threshold_90d: Target value at verdict-date. Specific number.
outcome_metric_fields.kill_criterion: If threshold missed by X%, module is revised or formally archived.
outcome_metric_fields.verdict_date: ISO date — verdict-date from Locked-Initiatives.md (registry is canonical)

_schema.enforcement: Specs missing `outcome_metric` block are invalid. /myjkkn-chain Q0 enforces this gate at spec-time. Cross-domain commitments mirrored to ~/Vaults/JKKNKB/Strategy/Locked-Initiatives.md via /lock-initiative skill.

features.name: Startup Studio — Foundations (Level 0): pre-Appathon founder-formation on-ramp

outcome_metric.metric_name: appathon_conversion_rate_foundations: count(distinct Foundations-completers who registered AND submitted at the next Appathon) * 100 / count(distinct Foundations-completers)
outcome_metric.baseline_value: TBD — measure at launch. Cold-entry Appathon submission-rate among enrollees with NO Foundations completion. Read-only query in specs/startup-studio-foundations-level0-spec-2026-06-01.md §Q0 (hand to a Supabase-MCP session / Server Claude).
outcome_metric.threshold_90d: Foundations-completers submit at the next Appathon at >= cold-entry baseline + 20 percentage points (provisional per Director directive 2026-06-01; re-pin after baseline measured)
outcome_metric.kill_criterion: If completers convert at <= baseline (zero lift) at the first post-launch Appathon, the on-ramp failed to widen the funnel — revise curriculum sequencing OR archive Level 0. Do NOT extend the timeline to mask a flat result.
outcome_metric.verdict_date: first Appathon within 90 days of Phase-1 merge (EVENT-GATED, provisional — Appathons are not continuous; re-pin to the actual next Appathon date at launch)
outcome_metric.verdict_status: PENDING — baseline not yet measured; threshold provisional (+20pp)
